title: [29.x]-[WHT] Inconsistency with the Payments
summary: Backport to 29.x of a fix for withholding tax inconsistency with payments, changing the Withholding Tax Mgmt. codeunit. A test checks that posting a payment without a Purchases journal template fails with the expected missing template error.
key_points: Withholding Tax Mgmt. codeunit 6785 is modified in releases/29.x to address the payments inconsistency bug
Test added that verifies posting fails when the Purchases journal template is missing
Description only mentions test formatting, which understates the app code change
quote: Corrected the indentation and procedure closing structure.
